digest.component_or_area: tickets branch rewrite and epoch migration
propositions: Execute a one-time irreversible force-with-lease rewrite of the tickets branch to reclaim ~92% of repository size after A1-A5, A6-0a..0d, and Epic B's B6 are closed
Quiesce all writers (GitHub workflows, AWS timers, LaunchAgents, and active sessions) and validate zero in-flight state before publishing the rewrite

Verify pre-rewrite correctness (tree preservation, commit/merge-count invariance, event identity multiset preservation, old tip non-resurrection) on a scratch unfiltered clone before force-push to origin
Converge all 48 sibling worktrees and the review-bot live clone after publication and validate the deterministic first post-window write (review-bot LLM-Review vote) with size-pack growth < 1 MB
Re-pin rebar.toml identity.enforce_since to the post-rewrite mapped SHA via normal Gerrit workflow to complete the epoch guard deployment
Validate post-enable reconciliation state (dry-run/live passes, persisted state pushes, canary drift=0) and run rebar fsck to confirm no data loss after the rewrite
